test_item:
Import certificate
(ECU certificate is imported to the device)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. An ECU certificate file is available on the host
proc:
1. Push the ECU certificate file from the host to the DUT
$ adb push ecu.crt /data/misc/ecuidentity/
2. Confirm the content of /data/misc/ecuidentity on the DUT
$ adb shell ls -l /data/misc/ecuidentity
er:
1. PENDING: X-d ECU certificate chain for the DUT serial number + trigger
2. The adb shell ls -l /data/misc/ecuidentity output lists "ecu.crt"
design: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
source: 037 SYSAD_SEC_ECUCERT_ECUCERT_SRV_IMPORTCERT_INTF Requirement Description and Verification Criteria
sibling axis: import target; rule 1 of SEC-04 4.2
channel_feasible: Y/Y
